## D4-01 · A trailing comma after the CTE

> **GENERATED · written for this system (reinforces a concept from the source)**

| C4.5 | ★ |  | `longlist` | write a query |

Syntax error near SELECT. Fix it.

```sql
WITH "average_book_ratings" AS (
    SELECT "book_id", "year", ROUND(AVG("rating"), 2) AS "rating"
    FROM "ratings" JOIN "books" ON "ratings"."book_id" = "books"."id"
    GROUP BY "book_id"
),
SELECT "year", ROUND(AVG("rating"), 2) AS "rating"
FROM "average_book_ratings" GROUP BY "year";
```

## D4-02 · The soft-delete trigger that hid everything

> **SOURCE · question posed in the lecture**  
> Source: [lecture4 L1147-1153](../sources/lecture4.txt) *“with no condition it'll update all the columns here”*

| Topic / concepts | Difficulty | Skills | Dataset | Task type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C4.8 | ★★★ |  | `mfa` | change the database |

After creating this trigger, deleting one painting through the view makes **all** paintings disappear. Fix the trigger.

<details><summary>Setup</summary>

```sql
ALTER TABLE "collections" ADD COLUMN "deleted" INTEGER DEFAULT 0;
CREATE VIEW "current_collections" AS
SELECT "id", "title", "accession_number", "acquired" FROM "collections" WHERE "deleted" = 0;
```
</details>

```sql
CREATE TRIGGER "delete" INSTEAD OF DELETE ON "current_collections"
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    UPDATE "collections" SET "deleted" = 1;
END;
```

<details><summary>Bug type</summary>

`trigger`
</details>

Hints → [`hints/M4.md`](../hints/M4.md#d4-02) · Fix → [`solutions/M4.md`](../solutions/M4.md#d4-02)
